answer_1.quote: We evaluate COM-BOM using Qwen models (Qwen3-8B) and LLaMA models (LlaMA-3.3-70B) on an extensive collection of tasks from MMLU-Pro... The dataset consists of complex questions in English... where each question has at most 10 options.

answer_2.quote: Our evaluation procedure... involves... Per-Instance Accuracy: The accuracy for this single input x given z, denoted acc(x, z), is 1 if ans(x, z) matches the ground truth label y, and 0 otherwise. After processing all instances... Overall Predictive Accuracy (f_acc(z))... The ECE for exemplar set z is the weighted average of the absolute differences between average accuracy and average confidence
